effect_description_eng:
When you would use this card, if you have 2 or more suspended green Digimon in play, reduce the memory cost by 2.
[Main] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon to the bottom of its owner's deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
